name: How long does it take to install and finish bathroom drywall?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install and finish bathroom drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical bathroom drywall installation usually takes 2 to 4 days from hanging boards to final sanding. Hanging the drywall panels takes less than a day for most standard residential bathrooms. The majority of the timeline depends on the taping, mudding, and drying cycles. Joint compound requires three separate coats, and each coat must dry completely before the next layer is applied. High ambient humidity or poor ventilation can extend drying times between coats. Once the final skim coat is dry, a light sanding and dust cleanup complete the drywall phase before priming.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing and finishing bathroom drywall typically takes 2 to 4 days, primarily due to the drying times required between multiple coats of joint compound.
